raw_record.question_text: Four ribbons $\mathrm{M}, \mathrm{N}, \mathrm{P}$ and $\mathrm{Q}$ are wrapped around a box. In which order were they wrapped around the box?

method.method_draft: Inspect the drawing of the wrapped box and identify the visible over-under relations at ribbon crossings. First note the labeled ribbons: N is the hatched ribbon near the rear/top, M is the light gray lengthwise ribbon on top/front, Q is the dark horizontal ribbon around the front/side, and P is the dotted ribbon crossing over the top/front/side. At each crossing, the ribbon drawn uninterrupted/on top must have been wrapped later than the one it covers. Read the crossings: M lies over N on the top, so N was before M; Q lies over M on the front face, so M was before Q; P lies over Q on the side/front crossing, so Q was before P. Combine these constraints to get the wrapping order N, M, Q, P.
